主要内容: The 2015 Honda CR-V won the Compact SUV Challenge, beating six competitors in expert and customer evaluations. The CR-V was praised for its rewarding driving experience, generous interior room, and family-friendly features. It features upgrades to styling, performance, fuel efficiency, and technology. The competition included seven popular compact SUVs, with vehicles required to cost less than $28,000 and achieve at least 26 mpg. Honda, which produces over 1.92 million vehicles annually in North America, noted the CR-V's continued popularity as America's top SUV choice. Patrick Olsen, Cars.com editor-in-chief, highlighted the CR-V's blend of interior space, visibility, and driving experience. The win reflects customer and expert consensus on the CR-V's value in the competitive compact SUV segment.
